gre-readiness-check-quant-143.prompt: How many three-digit positive integers are divisible by 7?
gre-readiness-check-quant-143.explanation: The three-digit integers run from 100 through 999. The smallest multiple of 7 in that range is 105 (7 × 15) and the largest is 994 (7 × 142). The count is 142 − 15 + 1 = 128. Equivalently, ⌊999/7⌋ − ⌊99/7⌋ = 142 − 14 = 128.

distractorExplanations.a: 127 is an off-by-one: 142 − 15 = 127 drops the inclusive +1 on the 105-to-994 count.
distractorExplanations.c: 129 would be 142 − 14 + 1, which treats 98 as a three-digit multiple (it is two-digit).
distractorExplanations.d: 142 is ⌊999/7⌋, the count of positive multiples of 7 up to 999, including 7 through 98.
